name: Adagio (joint venture of Accor and Pierre & Vacances Center Parcs)
via: Joint venture between Accor and Pierre & Vacances Center Parcs
note: The FDJ-SUEZ communiqué of 16 June 2025 does not give the shareholding split between the two parents (widely reported elsewhere as 50/50 — not sourced here). Accor and Groupe Pierre & Vacances - Center Parcs are listed companies; Pierre & Vacances' shareholders were not traced. Accor's 2025 Universal Registration Document (ownership structure at 31 December 2025) shows Qatar Holding LLC (Qatar sovereign fund QIA) at 6.61% of Accor's capital and 11.16% of voting rights, with two directors on Accor's board — see the adagio sponsor note.
